NONE: A2 used to express possibility
（表示可能性）可能，也許
B1 formal used to ask or give permission
（用於請求許可或表示允許）可以
› formal used to introduce a wish or a hope
（表示祝願或希望）祝，願
› the flowers of the hawthorn tree
山楂花
A1 the fifth month of the year, after April and before June
五月

example: There may be other problems that we don't know about.
可能有我們不知道的其他問題。
I may see you tomorrow before I leave.
明天我走前也許還能見到你。
The cause of the accident may never be discovered.
意外的起因也許永遠無法查清。
The explosion may have been caused by a faulty electrical connection.
爆炸可能是由電路連接錯誤引起的。
We'd better not interfere - she may not like it.
我們最好別干涉——她可能會不高興。
There may be some evidence to suggest she's guilty, but it's hardly conclusive.
也許有跡象顯示她有罪，但不怎麼令人信服。
A reader may borrow up to six books at any one time.
讀者一次最多可借閱六本書。
"May I help myself to some more food?" "Yes, of course."
「我能再取些吃的嗎？」「好的，當然可以。」
Hi, my name's Tiffany. How may I help you?
「你好，我叫蒂芙妮，能幫你做些甚麼嗎？」
May you have a long and fruitful marriage.
祝你們婚姻長久美滿。
My mother's birthday is in May.
我母親的生日是在五月。
They got married on 12 May.
他們是在5月12日結婚的。
We're supposed to be moving into new offices next May.
我們預計明年五月搬到新的辦公室去。

NONE: › the first day of May, a holiday in many countries. It traditionally celebrates spring but now it is often used to honour workers.
五一勞動節；五朔節
› used in questions to show disapproval
（用於疑問句表示不贊同）能問一下…嗎

example: What, may I ask, was the point of repeating the tests?
我想問一下，重複這些測試的目的是甚麼？

NONE: › said before a race or competition, meaning that you want the person who is the fastest, strongest, or most skilled to win or succeed
但願最佳選手獲勝。
B2 If you say that something may well happen, you mean that it is likely to happen.
很有可能

example: She may well not want to travel alone.
她很有可能不想獨自旅行。

NONE: B2 used to suggest doing something, often when there is nothing better to do
（反正也沒有更好的辦法）要不就…

example: We might as well walk there.
我們要不就步行去那裡吧。
We may as well start the meeting - the others will be here soon.
我們要不開始開會吧——其他的人很快會來的。

NONE: A2 used to show that something is possible or that something might be true
或許，大概
› informal used to show that a number or amount is approximate
（表示近似數量）約
A2 used to politely suggest or ask for something
（禮貌地表示建議、請求）也許
› used to avoid giving a clear or certain answer to a question
（用於不確定的回答）可能，也許
› used to mean that something is a possible explanation for why something else happened
（用於解釋原因）可能，也許

example: Maybe they'll come tomorrow.
或許他們明天會來。
Maybe you were right after all.
或許還是你對。
There were 200, maybe 300, refugees on the boat.
船上約有200或300名難民。
Maybe Ted would like to go.
也許特德願意去。
Maybe we should start again.
或許我們該重新開始。
"Why were you chosen for the team and not me?" "Maybe it's because I've been to more practices than you."
「為甚麼球隊選中了你，而不是我？」「也許是因為我參加訓練的次數比你多。」

NONE: › a special radio signal sent from a ship or an aircraft when it needs help
（船隻、飛機發出的）無線電求救訊號
› a condition in which a female is born without a vagina and uterus
先天性陰道缺失症候群，MRKH氏症候群
› an insect that lives near water and only lives for a very short time as an adult
蜉蝣
› a situation in which there is little or no order or control
混亂狀態

example: With 20 kids running around and only two adults to supervise, it was complete mayhem.
20個孩子到處亂跑卻只有兩個大人看管，完全是一片混亂。

NONE: › a thick, white sauce made from oil, vinegar, and the yellow part of eggs, usually eaten cold
（油、醋和蛋黃調製而成的）蛋黃醬
B2 a person who is elected or chosen to lead the group who governs a town or city
市長
› the office of being a mayor, or the period of time for which someone is a mayor
市長職位；市長任期
› a female mayor, or the wife of a mayor
女市長；市長夫人
› a tall pole with long ribbons (= narrow strips of cloth) attached to the top of it, the ends of which people hold as they dance around the pole on the first of May
五朔節花柱（慶祝五朔節時，人們繞此柱跳舞，手拉從柱子頂部垂下的彩帶）
